title: REQ · A guard test reads the real package.json and lockfile and asserts 3.90.x
summary: Guard test on disk files fails if phaser regresses to 4.x
description: Context: the lockfile root specifier and the cross-file agreement are unchecked. Desired behavior: a guard test reads both real files and asserts the helper returns no problems and that the specifiers agree. Expected result: a regression to 4.x fails the test. Why: closes the SG-4.1.4 done criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Given the real files, when the guard test runs, then it passes
Given the real files, when the test reads lock.packages[''].dependencies.phaser, then it equals package.json dependencies.phaser

in_scope: Script to run the guard test
